note: q27: gaps measured on v5f vs Leo at equal D. Geometry steps need a rebuild (sdf_head SECT / ears / face_paint); shading steps are pc_v2 skin material knobs.

corrections.description: Widen the chin and lower jaw so the outline turns at a soft jaw corner near the mouth line and ends in a broad rounded chin (~0.5 D wide), not a V.

corrections.description: Move the ears up and shorten them so the bottom sits about 0.38 D below the pupils, and tuck them closer to the head.

corrections.description: Lower the brows onto the upper lash (brow-to-pupil gap 0.16 -> 0.09 D) and angle them down toward the nose.

corrections.description: Make the iris fill the height of the eye opening, touching the lower lid, with sclera only at the sides.

corrections.description: Add painted soft-edged shadows: a band under the fringe across the forehead and a broad shadow down the far side of the face, warm orange-brown.
